races.paceDynamic: Irina's Path represents the sole confirmed front-runner in this 13-runner field, likely to dictate terms from the start with Fr Gilligansvoyge potentially providing some early company from a prominent position. With the majority of the field consisting of hold-up horses including Last Round, Asphalt Cowboy, Hey Sir, Hearts And Spades, and Squire Ohara, the pace will be controlled and sustainable early before building through the second half. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those capable of tracking the pace, as the hold-up brigade will face a tough task getting competitive from off what promises to be a moderate gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Irina's Path leads uncontested and the pace stays steady until the home turn
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows patient types to position well and the race becomes a tactical affair decided by class and finishing kick. Hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with time to organize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Positioning Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Fr Gilligansvoyge or another runner challenges Irina's Path early
scenarios.body: The increased tempo tests the stamina of closers and favors those who can travel kindly in behind the leaders. Horses tracking the pace get first run on the field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Irina's Path goes too slow early and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: A sprint finish develops where positioning matters more than running style and the best-handicapped horses prevail. Traffic problems multiply in a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Irina's Path gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The pace-setter builds an unassailable advantage as the hold-up horses leave their challenges too late on the testing ground. Class tells from the front.

watchPoints.text: Irina's Path could struggle with fitness after 268 days off despite being the lone pace-setter, potentially setting this up for closers.
Last Round represents the Gordon Elliott stable in excellent form but the 83-day break and preference for better ground could blunt his effectiveness.
Traffic problems likely in the home straight with so many hold-up horses converging simultaneously from off the likely steady pace.
Asphalt Cowboy's excellent course record and recent consistency make him the most reliable of the hold-up brigade.
The going has been called yielding all day at Punchestown, potentially favoring those with proven form on similar surfaces.

races.paceDynamic: Panda Boy will dictate terms from the front with no obvious challengers for the early lead, creating a sustainable gallop over this extended trip. The prominent runners Its On The Line, Asian Master, Lets Go Champ and Wonderwall will track within striking distance but none are aggressive enough to pressure the leader early. This sets up a tactical finish where stamina and late acceleration become crucial, with the hold-up horses Hunters Yarn and Five Star Getaway potentially swooping late if the pace becomes too sedate. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can stay close to Panda Boy and outfinish him, as the controlled tempo will leave plenty in reserve for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Panda Boy maintains a steady but not overly strong gallop and the pace doesn't collapse completely.
scenarios.body: The measured tempo allows the prominent runners to conserve energy while staying close enough to strike, with Its On The Line and Wonderwall best positioned to capitalize on their superior ratings and recent form. The lack of early pressure means they won't be stretched for stamina and can use their class advantage in the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too pedestrian and creates gaps for late runners to exploit.
scenarios.body: Hunters Yarn and Five Star Getaway benefit from a collapse in tempo, allowing them to make up significant ground in the straight with their finishing kicks. The extended distance plays into their hands as stamina becomes the deciding factor over speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Panda Boy Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If no horse is willing or able to put serious pressure on the leader throughout the race.
scenarios.body: The uncontested lead allows Panda Boy to dictate his preferred fractions and kick clear when it matters, using his front-running tactics to maximum effect. His recent course-and-distance success gives him confidence to hold on despite carrying top weight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners decides to apply sustained pressure from halfway, creating a truly-run race.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and exposes stamina limitations, favoring horses with proven staying power and strong recent form. This tactical shift could catch some horses out but suits those who have shown they can handle a genuine test.

races.paceDynamic: Dinoblue and Spindleberry will dispute the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to engage from the start in this small field. Their duel should create a solid gallop that opens up the race in the final half-mile, particularly given the yielding ground conditions. Kala Conti and Only By Night will sit prominent behind the pace, while the lower-rated pair will struggle to get competitive. This honest pace favors the prominent runners who can track the leaders and pounce when the front two tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Two Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Dinoblue and Spindleberry burn each other out with their early battle
scenarios.body: The sustained pace on yielding ground takes its toll on both leaders, allowing the prominent trackers to sweep past in the final furlong. This creates the perfect setup for horses that can sit close but avoid the early heat.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: The class act uses her superior rating to establish a decisive advantage, then stays on strongly to the line. Her recent form edge and Mark Walsh's tactical nous prove decisive in a straightforward front-running display.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Spindleberry Battles Back
scenarios.trigger: If Spindleberry can match Dinoblue's early pace without overexerting
scenarios.body: The eight-year-old's stamina kicks in during the final half-mile, allowing her to edge past her stablemate. Paul Townend times his challenge perfectly as the yielding ground plays to her staying power.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Kala Conti Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is particularly strong and both leaders fade dramatically
scenarios.body: The Gordon Elliott mare's prominent style allows her to avoid the early battle while staying close enough to strike. Jack Kennedy produces her with a perfectly timed run that catches the weakening front-runners.

races.paceDynamic: Kiss Will, You Oughta Know, Port Joulain and Karamoja will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with 10 prominent runners creating significant congestion through the middle stages. The strong pace will stretch the field and test stamina credentials over this 2m4½f trip, particularly on yielding ground that demands more from horses. Traffic problems are inevitable 2-3 out as the prominent brigade converges, potentially compromising several chances. This race setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early melee and deliver late, with stamina more important than speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine and traffic causes chaos in the prominent ranks
scenarios.body: The strong gallop and congestion will play into the hands of horses held up off the pace who can pick up the pieces late. Patient tactics will be rewarded as the pace collapses in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Survivor Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure a clear passage and handle the pace
scenarios.body: Despite the congestion, a well-positioned prominent runner with tactical speed gets first run on the leaders. Class and stamina tell as they pull clear of the hold-up horses who face too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Mid-Div
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast and the prominent ranks get shuffled back
scenarios.body: The genuine early gallop sets up a sprint finish where horses tracking in fourth or fifth can strike. Mid-division runners with tactical pace benefit from the perfect position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Kiss Will or You Oughta Know can dictate at a sensible tempo
scenarios.body: One of the natural leaders gets an easy time in front and has enough stamina to see off late challengers. The yielding ground aids their cause by preventing a sustained late charge.

races.paceDynamic: Kiely's Place and Jalon d'Oudairies will engage early as the two confirmed front runners, with Kiely's Place likely to take them along at a reasonable clip given his proven leading ability. Four runners (King Rasko Grey, You Proof, Kalypso'chance, Echoing Silence) all want prominent positions behind the leaders, creating significant congestion and potential traffic problems approaching the business end. The pace should be honest throughout with these two leaders ensuring no tactical crawl, before the race develops into a proper test from three out. This race shape favours prominent runners with tactical speed who can avoid the mid-pack squeeze and position themselves to strike.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If King Rasko Grey or Kalypso'chance can secure ideal positions tracking the leaders without getting caught in traffic
scenarios.body: The honest gallop sets up perfectly for horses with tactical speed to pick off the leaders in the final half-mile. Both have the class and running style to capitalize when the front two weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Kiely's Place gets an uncontested lead and can dictate fractions to suit
scenarios.body: His proven course form and Willie Mullins polish means he could kick clear approaching the last when others are still fighting for position. The 26-day break keeps him fresh for a sustained effort.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong early and the prominent runners compromise each other
scenarios.body: Lord Byron can use his hold-up style to avoid the early battles and produce his trademark late rally. Harry Cobden's tactical nous becomes crucial in threading through traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace scenario creates complete traffic carnage in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get stuck behind struggling leaders while You Proof or Saint Baco find racing room on the outside. Their fresher profiles could tell in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If one of the three leaders can establish a controlling position without being harried
scenarios.body: The winner settles into a rhythm while rivals burn energy in pursuit, then uses class to pull clear when challenged. Front-runners with tactical speed benefit most from this tempo control.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders maintain their effort and turn it into a war of attrition
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of pure staying power where class and stamina combine to separate the best from the rest. The fittest horse on the day prevails through sustained pressure.

races.paceDynamic: Pioneer Pete, Lincoln Du Seuil, and Walhaan will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with Pioneer Pete showing the most consistent front-running form and likely to dictate terms. The large field of 28 runners means positioning will be crucial, but the genuine pace should prevent any tactical surprises and create a true test of stamina over this 2-mile trip. The strong early gallop will stretch the field and expose any stamina limitations, particularly on this yielding ground which will sap energy reserves. This race shape heavily favours prominent racers and hold-up horses with genuine stamina, as they can position themselves to strike when the pace-setters weaken in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Pioneer Pete maintains his lead and the three front-runners stay prominent to halfway
scenarios.body: The relentless pace will string out the field and favour horses with proven stamina who can finish strongly. Hold-up horses like Spirou, Chichester Park and Half A Chance can pick off the tiring leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Burn Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too fast early and all fade from 3 furlongs out
scenarios.body: This creates opportunities for prominent racers who avoided the early burn to inherit the lead and stay on strongly. Horses like Arslan, Tatateo and Dee's Lady can capitalise on better positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Pioneer Pete gets pulled back early and Lincoln Du Seuil also restrains the pace
scenarios.body: A messy, stop-start affair would suit horses who can quicken and have tactical speed rather than pure stamina. This brings Saveforarainyday and Nelson Muntz into contention with their versatility.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Pioneer Pete gets an easy lead with the other two pace-setters tracking him kindly
scenarios.body: The leader could steal a march turning for home if the pace isn't strong enough to stop him. Pioneer Pete's recent form suggests he has the class to make all if not pressured early enough.

watchPoints.text: Pioneer Pete and Lincoln Du Seuil must both race prominently early or the pace will collapse and upset all calculations
Chichester Park and Half A Chance need to be positioned within striking distance at halfway despite their hold-up styles
Watch for any market moves on Arslan as the Mullins string are in good form and he has solid claims
Amateur jockeys on Theflyingbee, Positive Energy and High Court Cave add tactical uncertainty in large field
The going is riding slower than advertised so stamina will be at more of a premium than usual

races.paceDynamic: Cityofblindinlites and Thinkitdontjinxit will engage from the start, with both having proven leading tendencies and the stamina for this 2m3f trip. Premier Division and Heldam should track close behind this early pace, creating a solid gallop throughout. With 23 runners and the yielding ground likely testing stamina reserves, the pace will be searching rather than pedestrian. This race shape clearly favors prominent racers and hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as the early leaders may weaken in the final furlong on this testing surface.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too strong and the leaders weaken significantly in the final 2f
scenarios.body: The searching gallop will find out the stamina of Cityofblindinlites and Thinkitdontjinxit, allowing patient riders to pick up the pieces. Strong stayers like Largy Star and Muckanagh Lough can capitalize with their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent racers strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is honest but not severe enough to stop the pace-tracking horses
scenarios.body: Premier Division and Heldam can utilize their tactical speed to position perfectly and strike when the leaders tire. Their prominent style allows them to avoid traffic while staying close enough to pounce.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader stays strong
scenarios.trigger: If Cityofblindinlites or Thinkitdontjinxit can dictate a controlled tempo early
scenarios.body: The front-runner who gets the easiest lead can build an unassailable advantage on this stamina-testing ground. Martin Brassil's excellent recent form gives Cityofblindinlites the edge in execution.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Improver emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the form horses disappoint and one of the lightly-raced contenders steps forward significantly
scenarios.body: The yielding ground and competitive pace could see a progressive type like Denham Rock or Macdonagh Park outrun their odds. Their fresher profiles may prove advantageous in this demanding contest.

watchPoints.text: Cityofblindinlites and Thinkitdontjinxit may go too fast early and collapse, opening door for hold-up horses
Several lightly raced horses like Denham Rock and Macdonagh Park could outrun odds if stepping forward significantly
Long-absent horses Premier Division, Killultagh Fox and Ned Hill may need the run despite their stable connections
Amateur riders on Denham Rock, Lyrical Park and Tubberfinn Gordon add execution risk in competitive field
The yielding going may play more to stamina than speed, potentially favoring the patient hold-up types
